headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 1,072.9 Million Dollars From 947.0 Million, Led By Binance
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to a 1,072.9 million dollar inflow, 0.3926 percent of the 273.3 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from a 947.0 million dollar inflow at 0.3462 percent. Binance accounts for 680.8 million dollars of the current intake, Bitfinex for 199.3 million, Gate for 196.2 million, and Deribit for 123.8 million, while Bitstamp posted a 202.1 million dollar outflow. The pipe sums the 24-hour change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the higher print means more clean-asset value arrived than on the prior reading, and Binance was the largest arrival.
author: jordan
